findings.title: A journal entry disappears from the plant page when deleting it fails
findings.expected: When the delete request fails, the entry stays in the list next to the error, because it is still in the database.
findings.actual: The entry is removed from the list before the request is sent and never comes back. With a 500 the page shows 'Injected 500' and 'No journal entries yet', but the entry is still in the database.

findings.title: A malformed journal response is shown as a list of blank entries
findings.expected: An unreadable response shows an error, not entries.
findings.actual: The page says '14 entries' and lists 14 cards that contain only '–', with no error.
